subject: CleverCart peak-hour impact — request for SLO window confirmation and logs
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@clevercart.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: support@clevercart.com
Date: Thu, 15 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sudden 5–12 min checkout failures during peak (12:08–12:20 UTC) — asking for SLO confirmation

Hi Vanessa,

We saw a sharp uptick in 500s and timeouts impacting our checkout flow during our US-east peak window this morning (approximately 12:08–12:20 UTC). The failures correlate with a spike in token errors and repeated retrying from our side; attached is a short sample of errors and a screenshot from our monitoring.

Can Redwood confirm whether this maps to an availability disruption on your side and advise whether this will qualify as an SLA event? We need the precise service window and any telemetry you can provide for our postmortem.

This incident caused ~7% drop in completed checkouts during that 12-minute window — enough that our ops and revenue teams are escalated.

Appreciate a quick confirmation of the impacted interval and the steps to obtain the raw traces/logs.

— Priya
Priya Shah
SRE Lead, CleverCart
priya.shah@clevercart.com

Attachments: tenant_request_screenshot.png, clevercart_error_samples.zip
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@clevercart.com>
Cc: david_kim@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Feb 2028 09:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Sudden 5–12 min checkout failures during peak (12:08–12:20 UTC) — asking for SLO confirmation

Hi Priya — thanks for the heads-up and the attachments. I'm sorry for the hit during your peak. We're opening an internal investigation now.

Immediate ask from our side: can you confirm the tenant-id and the exact request IDs (if available) from the sample? That will speed the match to our traces. Meanwhile I'm looping in our on-call infra lead, David Kim, and Laura from Customer Ops so we can:

- Verify the precise service window from Redwood telemetry (start/end + any partial degradations)
- Pull raw trace bundles and request-level logs for that tenant and provide a secure link to you
- Assess eligibility for a proportional SLO credit and timeline for the postmortem

David/Laura — Priya included a screenshot and an error sample. Priya: we may ask for an expanded log bundle if request-ids aren't all present in your sample.

I'll follow up within 2 business hours with the confirmed window and an ETA for the logs.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
From: david_kim@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, Priya Shah <priya.shah@clevercart.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Feb 2028 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Sudden 5–12 min checkout failures during peak (12:08–12:20 UTC) — asking for SLO confirmation

Priya / Vanessa — quick technical summary from our initial pass:

- We see an elevated 5xx rate for the CleverCart tenant in us-east-1 between 12:07:40 UTC and 12:19:50 UTC — ~12m10s total.
- Root cause appears to be a rapid transient KV cache eviction on a small subset of host shards that caused repeated cold starts for long-tail requests; that in turn pushed some requests into a retry spiral.
- No control-plane change or deploy during that interval. There was an autoscaler activity that overlapped at 12:05 UTC but it completed prior to the spike.

Next steps (we will: )
1) Assemble per-request traces for the tenant for 12:00–12:30 UTC and redact PII.
2) Create a secure Drive folder with raw logs + filtered event timelines and an index (ETA 6–8 hours).
3) Evaluate SLO eligibility using the contract's rolling-window rules and provide a recommendation for prorated credit.

Laura — can you confirm if CleverCart has an active reserved-capacity commitment (that affects the credit calculation) or is on metered/hosted terms? Vanessa, please include the contract tier in the thread.

Attaching our short spec for how we'll package traces (request_for_trace_specs.txt) so the customer knows format and redaction steps.

— David
David Kim
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@clevercart.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: david_kim@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Feb 2028 11:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Sudden 5–12 min checkout failures during peak (12:08–12:20 UTC) — asking for SLO confirmation

Hi Priya — quick follow-up with the service window confirmation and next steps: 

- Confirmed impacted window (Redwood telemetry): 2028-02-15T12:07:40Z → 2028-02-15T12:19:50Z (12m10s).
- We've created a secure Drive folder and uploaded the initial trace bundle + index: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cC-clevercart-logs-DC-8721 (contains redacted traces + a readme).
- Preliminary SLO eligibility: Given your plan is hosted (metered) and the rolling-30d availability threshold was breached for that minute distribution, we recommend this is a qualifying event for a prorated credit. Finance will calculate the exact amount; we'll route that through your A/R contact.

Action items for CleverCart: please confirm the tenant-id and any additional request-ids you can share. If you'd like, we can schedule a short postmortem with engineering and ops (30 min) — proposed times: Mon 2028-02-20 16:00 UTC or Tue 2028-02-21 11:00 UTC.

Thanks for flagging this — we'll follow up with the formal RCAs and the credit amount once Finance completes the computation.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Customer Reliability Lead, Redwood Inference
